title: On-Call — Active Pages & Correlation
description: Managed by Terraform (stacks/foundation). Everything a responder needs during a page: active alerts, correlated events, recent changes, workflow runs.

definition.title: Responder crib sheet
definition.content:
1. Ack the page (5/10 min SLA by severity).
2. Open the **runbook** linked in the alert — diagnostics workflow output is attached to the event.
3. Check *Recent changes* above: most pages resolve to a deployment.
4. Escalation: ack timeout auto-escalates via the team escalation policy; manual escalation handles are in the runbook.
5. Sev1: incident is auto-created — join the incident channel.
